## Runs 6 & 7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: electron n = +3.2×10¹² and hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Raw first, then per-tone onsets (`sdh_onset`) and the 1/B FFT against F_L and the forward model (`tetralayer_fs_count`).

**Read — run 6 (electron, F_L = 33.1 T):** oscillations from below the record's usable edge (onset **censored at 0.3 T** — and the 0–1 T leg was 50 mT-coarse, which undersamples the 7.1 T tone below ≈ 0.85 T, so the true onset is *unmeasured*, only bounded ≲ 1 T). Dominant tone **7.1 T** ≈ ABAB light-pocket prediction 7.31 T; higher content at 14.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 T is comb-flagged (~2/3/4 × 7.1) — but 22.1 is also near a rescaled ABAB heavy tone (25.8 × 0.86) and 29.5 ≈ 7.1 + 22.1 sits near a rescaled F_L: the pair {7.1, 22.1} sums to 29.2 with partition 0.24/0.76 (model ABAB 0.22/0.78) at a global density rescale ≈ 0.88 — inside the lever-arm prior. **Harmonic vs heavy-tone is exactly the fan's question** (a harmonic tracks k·f; a real pocket follows its own Onsager curve in n).

**Read — run 7 (hole, F_L = 12.4 T):** clean oscillations, onset 0.71 T. Model ABAB hole pair {5.9, 6.5} is close-and-balanced (the recipe's stated near-CNP exception — beat-like); observed 6.6 strong + 4.7, plus a **strong 12.3 T tone at F_L**. An ABCA hole singleton at F_L carries m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ — LK-dead at this rig's T_e ≈ 8 K — so a *strong* F_L tone here is more consistent with a sum/breakdown tone over an ABAB-like pair than with an ABCA pocket; hedged, since the mount→device T offset is uncharacterized. Whole hole side sits in the low-|n| exception regime (|n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² at the gate limits).

**Both spots lean two-pocket (ABAB-like) with the F_L sum-tone confound live on both sides — the discrimination is F(n) trajectories, i.e. the fan.** Fan side: **electron** — it alone reaches the design band |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² where the templates separate; the hole side never leaves the exception regime. Fan inherits: sr1 50 µV, τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB settling discipline, Δ(1/B) from F_L(3.2e12), onset ≲ 1 T pending the low-field extension (next cell).

"""Runs 6 & 7 — sdh-spot-check read: onset + tone set vs F_L and the model."""
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

SENS, GAIN_CUR = 50e-6, -1e6

# Model predictions at the two spots (hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count/fs_count_b0.py,
# abab_fs/abca_fs/abab_mstar/abca_mstar at the run-5-calibrated densities):
MODEL = {
    6: dict(n=+3.2e12, abab=(7.31, 25.78), abab_m=(0.027, 0.061), abca=33.08, abca_m=0.074),
    7: dict(n=-1.2e12, abab=(5.86, 6.54), abab_m=(0.032, 0.074), abca=12.41, abca_m=1.122),
}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
onsets = {}
for col, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r, mdl = run(rid), MODEL[rid]
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    I = r.col("sr0_X") / GAIN_CUR
    R = r.col("sr1_X") / I
    idx = np.argsort(B)
    B, R = B[idx], R[idx]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(mdl["n"] * 1e4)

    ax = axes[0, col]                                   # raw first
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.5)
    ax.set(title=f"run {rid}: n={mdl['n']/1e12:+.1f}e12, D=0 — raw Rxx(B)",
           xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ω)")

    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=SENS / np.median(np.abs(I)))
    print(f"=== run {rid} (n = {mdl['n']/1e12:+.1f}e12, F_L = {FL:.1f} T) ===")
    print(on.summary())
    onsets[rid] = on

    bmask = B >= 0.3
    p = np.polyfit(B[bmask], R[bmask], 5)
    ax = axes[1, col]
    ax.plot(B[bmask], R[bmask] - np.polyval(p, B[bmask]), lw=0.5)
    ax.axvline(on.onset_b, color="r", ls="--", label=f"onset {on.onset_b:.2f} T")
    ax.legend()
    ax.set(title=f"run {rid}: ΔRxx (deg-5 bg in B)", xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="ΔRxx (Ω)")

    ax = axes[2, col]
    for cut, style in [(max(on.onset_b, 0.5), "-"), (1.6, "--")]:
        freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, B.max()), bg_degree=5)
        ax.plot(freqs, spec[0] / spec[0].max(), style, lw=1, label=f"cutoff {cut:.2f} T")
    ax.axvline(FL, color="k", ls=":", label=f"F_L {FL:.1f} T")
    for f, c, lab in [(mdl["abab"][0], "tab:green", "ABAB light"),
                      (mdl["abab"][1], "tab:orange", "ABAB heavy"),
                      (mdl["abca"], "tab:red", "ABCA")]:
        ax.axvline(f, color=c, ls=":", alpha=0.8, label=f"{lab} {f:.1f} T")
    ax.set(xlim=(0, 1.4 * FL), title=f"run {rid}: FFT in 1/B (norm.)", xlabel="F (T)")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7)

fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

## HERA — Landau fan, step 0: low-field onset extension (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹², B 0.25 → 0.95 T

> **05:28** · sdh-spot-check low-B extension: n=+3.2e12 D=0 electron spot, B 0.25->0.95 T uniform 3 mT (234 pts), sr1 50 uV, delay 0, leak guard 1 nA; pins fan B\_lo · **ETA ~05:53** (≈25 min)

The fan (next cell) goes electron-side: only n > 0 reaches the investigation's design band |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² where ABAB heavy (25.8 T) vs ABCA singleton (33.1 T) separate; the hole side never leaves the low-|n| exception regime. Its `B_lo` lever must be the **measured** onset — but run 6's carrying tone (7.1 T) is censored at the record's low edge, and the 0–1 T leg's 50 mT grid undersamples that tone below ≈ 0.85 T, so the onset is only bounded ≲ 1 T. This is the recipe's cheap pin: same spot as run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0), fine uniform-B (3 mT ≈ Nyquist-⅓ on 7.1 T at 0.25 T), 0.25 → 0.95 T riding the fan's own positioning ramp — it ends at 0.95 T with gates at the fan's top density, so nothing is re-traversed. Doubles as the grid-change reproduction check on the 7.1 T tone (alias vs real). Read: `sdh_onset` → fan `B_lo` = max(measured onset, 0.8 T cost floor); if the tone is still censored at 0.25 T, `B_lo` stays 0.8 T (cost floor, see fan cell). Preconditions: base T, B ≈ 0 (handoff state0), Si 0, nplci 1. Leak guard 1 nA. Checkpoint: first rows via hera-watch (signal ~50–70 Ω on 5 kΩ FS, gate currents at pA floor).

# === Low-field onset extension (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0.25 -> 0.95 T, 3 mT ===
# Run 6's carrying tone (7.1 T) is CENSORED at the record edge (0.3 T), and the 0-1 T leg
# was 50 mT-coarse (undersamples 7.1 T below ~0.85 T). landau-fan step 1: pin B_lo before
# committing the fan. 3 mT ~ Nyquist-1/3 on the 7.1 T tone at 0.25 T; fast tones have
# onsets >= 1.4 T and no support down here.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff state0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.25, 0.9501, 0.003), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)  # same 5 kOhm FS as runs 6/7 (R here ~50-120 Ohm)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check low-field extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.25 -> 0.95 T, 3 mT, sr1 50 uV; pins fan B_lo (run-6 onset censored)")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset extension, electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = 0; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0.25 -> 0.95 T uniform-B 3 mT; '
              f'pins landau-fan B_lo (run-6 carrying tone censored at 0.3 T on a 50 mT leg)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.95 T — the fan starts here (B_lo <= 0.95). No park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
